action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with 2000 evals and no incumbent; probing first (≈12% = 240 evals) will characterize the landscape and seed the archive with diverse samples. The objective is deterministic and cheap, so probe data are fully useful for warm-starting subsequent methods.

Probes indicate a smooth, near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972, P2 fdc=0.795), and L-BFGS-B already achieved strong improvements in 32 evals per start with best y=5735.05 (P4). Deterministic, cheap evaluations and zero coords at bounds favor fast local descent from the incumbent.

Probes indicate a smooth, nearly quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972) and L-BFGS-B just delivered a large gain (from 5735.05 to 218.12; improvement_in_tenure=5516.93) without reporting convergence or exhaustion. With 1662 evals left and active.lbfgsb still progressing, continuing should drive further descent efficiently.

The probes indicate a smooth, near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972, FDC=0.795), and L-BFGS-B is still making incremental progress (best 217.197, stall_evals=1, not exhausted). Given the recent but small improvement (217.399 → 217.197 over the last round), we’ll continue one more round before considering a change.

The landscape looks smooth and near-quadratic (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972), and L-BFGS-B is still improving with no exhaustion and only 2 stall evals; the incumbent just improved to 214.877 at eval 538. Continuing the same local solver should yield further small gains efficiently.

The landscape looks nearly quadratic (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972, FDC=0.795), favoring precise local refinement. L-BFGS-B has slowed after 600 evals with only ~0.84 gain last round (158.325→157.484) and stall_evals=5, so switching to a derivative-free local polish can squeeze more improvement near the incumbent. BOBYQA should handle box constraints well and complement the current point.

Bobyqa is still making steady gains (155.222 → 153.176 in the last 100 evals; 4.31 improvement over its 200-eval tenure) and reports not exhausted. Probes indicate a smooth, near-quadratic landscape (r2_quad_full=0.972), so continued local refinement is appropriate.

BOBYQA just improved the incumbent to 150.535 (from 153.176 at round start), stall_evals is only 1, and the solver is not exhausted. Probes indicate a near-quadratic, smooth landscape (P3 r2_quad_full=0.972), so continued local trust-region refinement is appropriate.

Probes indicate a smooth, near‑quadratic landscape (r2_quad_full=0.972, fdc_spearman=0.795), while bobyqa’s recent gains are modest (from 150.75 to 149.429 over ~113 evals; stall_evals=4). A short L-BFGS-B polish from the incumbent should accelerate local convergence on such problems.

L-BFGS-B is stalling (stall_evals=17) with just 0.160 improvement over 150 evals, and our last expectation failed (expected ≤148.9, got 149.268). Probes show a smooth quadratic-like landscape (r2_quad_full=0.972) yet top-10 solutions are fairly spread (spread_vs_uniform=0.774), so we’ll hedge with global/population methods to seek a better basin within 240 evals.

We have stalled for 257 evals at 149.268 (no improvement since eval 1376), and probes indicate a smooth near-quadratic landscape (P3 r2_quad_full_rank=0.9579). DE won the race but matched the incumbent (149.268) and shows broad but unfocused spread (pop_x_spread=2.66, huge fitness spread), so a fresh CMA-ES with larger population from a diverse start is a better bet to find a new basin within the remaining budget.

Best value has stalled at 149.268 for 457 evals (unchanged since eval 1495), and the current CMA-ES tenure of 200 evals achieved 0 improvement. Probes indicate a near-quadratic single basin (r2_quad_full=0.972), and neither DE nor further L-BFGS improved it with only 172 evals left, so additional progress is unlikely.
